response.description: Status code for the operation. (1) - success, (2) - failed, (3) system error

responsetext.description: Textual description of the operation's result.

amount_authorized.description: (Conditional) This will optionally come back when requesting partial payment. Authorization amount.

orderid.description: Identifier for an order related to this invoice.

type.description: Type of operation that this response is for.

partial_payment_id.description: (Conditional) This will optionally come back when requesting partial payment. A numeric identifier which is used when submitting subsequent transactions.

partial_payment_balance.description: (Conditional) This will optionally come back when requesting partial payment. The payment's remaining balance.

platform_id.description: Platform ID associated with the transaction.

response_code.description: Another status or result code for the operation. See [Response Code Table](#section/Appendixes/Payment-API-Response-Codes)

subscription_id.description: (Conditional - Subscription) The subscription ID that was created

emv_auth_response_data.description: (Conditional) This will optionally come back when any chip card data is provided on the authorization. This data needs to be sent back to the SDK after an authorization.

payment_terms.description: (Conditional - Invoice) The terms of payment for the invoice.

customer_vault_id.description:
(Conditional - Customer Vault) The original customer_vault_id passed in the transaction request or the resulting customer_vault_id created on an approved transaction.

Note: Only returned when the "Customer Vault" service is active.

kount_score.description:
The Kount "Omniscore" indicating the level of risk on a given transaction. The higher the score, the lower the risk.

Note: Only returned when the "Kount" service is active.
